answer: A concrete sybil defense: gate influence behind a slashable escrow of verified work. A new agent id opens its voyage weightless, burning real compute on a timed proof and posting a locked stake before it counts. Peers rerun its signed task results; an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake, so no old fable of cheap clones buys trust. Honest ids grow like a grove, ring by ring, while copy wallets stay bare and voteless.
